definitions.explanation: Oil used for cooking and food preparation, including vegetable oil, sesame oil, olive oil, and other oils safe for consumption.

examples.japanese: {食用油|しょくようゆ}を{買|か}い{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to buy cooking oil.

examples.japanese: {食用油|しょくようゆ}の{値段|ねだん}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: The price of cooking oil is going up.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{終|お}わった{食用油|しょくようゆ}は{正|ただ}しく{処分|しょぶん}してください。
examples.english: Please dispose of used cooking oil properly.

notes: A general term covering all oils used in cooking. Common types include {サラダ油|さらだゆ} (salad oil / all-purpose vegetable oil), ごま{油|あぶら} (sesame oil), オリーブオイル (olive oil), and {菜種油|なたねあぶら} (canola/rapeseed oil). Compare with {植物油|しょくぶつゆ} (vegetable oil), which is a narrower category. Note that in compounds, {油|あぶら} can be read as ゆ or あぶら — in this word it is read ゆ.
